_readme: Business details, written exactly as on the Google Business profile. Change them ONLY here, then run: python scripts/build.py
name: Καπαγερίδης Ιωάννης – Φανοποιείο · Βαφείο · PDR

reviews._readme: Google reviews on the home page. apiKey: a Google Maps Platform browser key with 'Maps JavaScript API' + 'Places API (New)' enabled, restricted to https://kapageridis.gr/* (and http://localhost:8080/* for testing). Google returns at most 5 reviews. minRating: show only reviews with at least this many stars (1 = all).

estimateForm._readme: Free damage estimate on /dorean-ektimisi/ (the «Δωρεάν εκτίμηση» / «Ζητήστε εκτίμηση» buttons lead there). endpoint = the Web app link of the Google Apps Script in the estimates Google Sheet (scripts/estimate-apps-script.gs): when set, the page shows the site's OWN form, which saves photos to Google Drive and adds a row to the Sheet, same columns as before, so Make needs no change. tallyId = old Tally form, used only while endpoint is empty. Then run: python scripts/build.py

analytics._readme: Google Analytics 4 'Measurement ID' (looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX). Empty = no statistics, no cookie banner. When set, every page shows a banner and GA4 loads ONLY after the visitor presses «Αποδοχή». Then run: python scripts/build.py
